onboarding.slide1Title: Do you know if you're profiting?
onboarding.slide1Desc: Many bakers sell a lot, but at the end of the month the money is gone. The problem is the price — calculated by guesswork, without considering all costs.
onboarding.slide2Title: Calculate the real cost of each recipe
onboarding.slide2Desc: Register your ingredients with price and quantity. DocePreco automatically calculates how much each gram, each unit and each complete recipe costs.
onboarding.slide3Desc: Choose how much you want to profit — 30%, 50%, 100% or more. The app shows the ideal selling price so you never work at a loss again.
onboarding.slide4Desc: Record what you sold, the quantity and the price. See your revenue by day, week or month and understand when your business grows.

beginnerGuide.completedSubtitle: You now know the basics to price your sweets safely.
beginnerGuide.title: Beginner Mode
beginnerGuide.subtitle: Follow the 3 steps below to start pricing your sweets safely.
beginnerGuide.completeBanner: Amazing! Now explore all features of the app.
beginnerGuide.step1Desc: Start by adding the ingredients you use in your recipes. Enter the name, package quantity and price paid.
beginnerGuide.step1Tip: Tip: Register at least 3 ingredients to build a complete recipe.
beginnerGuide.step2Desc: Now build a recipe using registered ingredients. Add each ingredient and the quantity used — the app calculates the cost automatically.
beginnerGuide.step2Tip: Tip: Start with your best-selling recipe. That way you'll find out right away if the price is right!
beginnerGuide.step3Desc: On the recipe screen, set the desired profit margin (e.g. 50%, 100%). The app calculates the ideal selling price so you never lose money.
beginnerGuide.step3Tip: Tip: Most bakers use margins between 50% and 150%. Start with 100% and adjust to your market.
